region: Singapore and Hong Kong booking centres; Dubai advisors serving accounts booked in Singapore
business_problem: Source of Wealth assessments require banks to establish and document how prospective clients accumulated their wealth. The research, documentation, and preparation involved manual and repetitive work during the Know Your Customer process.
solution_summary: Deutsche Bank’s Agentic AI-enabled Source of Wealth solution is integrated into the Bank’s digital KYC platform. It uses information from client documentation and approved external sources within a client case to automate research and documentation and prepare Source of Wealth data for KYC assessments. The AI helps identify gaps or inconsistencies, then supports preparation of assessments for human review; accountability and established controls remain with bank staff. The described serving path is the prepared assessment to human reviewers, supporting advisors and relationship managers during onboarding. The release does not specify data storage, underlying models, detailed processing steps, or named APIs and infrastructure products. The solution is live in Singapore and Hong Kong booking centres, and available to Dubai advisors for Singapore-booked accounts; broader Private Bank rollout is planned.
